subject: The Altruists (Netflix)
query: is the altruists a true story
title: Is The Altruists a true story? Netflix's FTX series, explained
answer: Yes. Netflix's "The Altruists" dramatizes the real rise and fall of the crypto exchange FTX, focusing on founder Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, former CEO of Alameda Research. Anthony Boyle plays Bankman-Fried and Julia Garner plays Ellison. The eight-episode limited series premieres on Netflix on Nov. 19, 2026.
body:
The series draws on reporting by Kevin T. Dugan and Jen Wieczner for New York magazine. Graham Moore, the Oscar-winning writer of "The Imitation Game," created it and is showrunner with Jacqueline Hoyt. Barack and Michelle Obama's Higher Ground Productions is among the producers. The cast also includes Paul Reiser and Robin Weigert as Bankman-Fried's parents, Joe Bankman and Barbara Fried, Matt Rife as Ryan Salame, Karan Soni as Nishad Singh and Eugene Young as Gary Wang.

In real life, a New York jury found Bankman-Fried guilty on seven counts of fraud and conspiracy in 2023, and Judge Lewis Kaplan sentenced him to 25 years in prison on March 28, 2024. A federal appeals court upheld his conviction on June 12, 2026. Ellison pleaded guilty, testified against him and was sentenced to two years in prison on Sept. 24, 2024.
in_the_news: Netflix releases "The Altruists," its limited series about the FTX collapse, on Nov. 19, 2026.
